# Spar 0.6.6

**A fix release. Every frosted surface in 0.6.5 — the menus, the composer, the
scroll fades — was flat in a packaged build, and the tutor could open "your
attempt" and read a file from two challenges ago.**

## The glass is frosted again

- **Packaged builds lost every backdrop blur.** `theme.css` wrote
  `-webkit-backdrop-filter` by hand beside `backdrop-filter`. Tailwind's
  lightningcss pass targets Safari 16.4, which still needs that prefix, so it
  prefixes the property itself — and finding an identical prefixed line already
  there, it collapsed the pair into a single prefixed declaration. Chromium has
  no `-webkit-backdrop-filter` at all, so the one declaration that survived did
  nothing. Development never runs that pass, which is why it only ever showed in
  a build.
- The prefix is the toolchain's job now. Safari still gets it, Chromium gets the
  property it actually honours, and a note above `.glass` says why it must not be
  written by hand again.

## Reading the attempt

- **`read_attempt` reads the files this attempt touched.** A session's workspace
  outlives its challenges, so listing the directory handed the agent whichever
  source file the filesystem named first — the learner watched their tutor open
  "your attempt" and read a function from two challenges ago. The files are the
  ones this attempt actually saved, most recent first.
- **The report survives the cap.** The transcript stores 16k of the result and
  draws the attempt panel out of the report, which was serialised after the
  whole-file dump and the raw event log — either of which can fill the cap alone.
  It goes ahead of both, so the panel has something to draw instead of falling
  back to raw JSON.
- **The code watermark behind the challenge card is gone.** Illegible text as a
  background is a texture, not a fact, and the code is one click away in the
  panel that opens under it.
